r5x8gw0c8gwm.name: Live support unavailable for merchants
r5x8gw0c8gwm.last_update: We've identified the root cause as an outage at Twilio, a service Shopify uses to connect live support calls and chats. Merchants may experience long wait times or be unable to connect with a specialist. Updates are available at status.twilio.com. We'll provide another update when we have more information to share.
